kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · Int J Gynecol Obstet 2025;171:405–414 · 前瞻队列
title: Cytologic DNA Methylation for Managing Minimally Abnormal Screening Results
title_zh: 细胞学 DNA 甲基化管理轻微异常筛查结果
subtitle: 1,857 women with ASC-US/LSIL/HPV+NILM — CISCER® sensitivity 74.9% / specificity 89.1% for CIN3+ (AUC 0.820)
subtitle_zh: 1,857 例 ASC-US/LSIL/HPV+NILM 女性——CISCER® 检测 CIN3+ 灵敏度 74.9% / 特异度 89.1%（AUC 0.820）
authors: Shang X, Kong L, You Y, Wu H, et al.
authors_zh: 商晓, 孔令华, 尤燕, 吴焕文 等
source: Int J Gynaecol Obstet 2025;171(1):405–414 · DOI 10.1002/ijgo.70167
source_zh: Int J Gynaecol Obstet 2025;171(1):405–414 · DOI 10.1002/ijgo.70167

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: minimally abnormal results (ASC-US, LSIL, HPV+/NILM) are the most common screening outcomes — their management varies, causing both over- and under-referral.
Question: can cytologic PAX1/JAM3 methylation triage these women for CIN3+ more accurately than current practice?
Why it matters: an objective test for the biggest screening group could standardize management and cut needless colposcopy.
bullets_zh: 空白：轻微异常结果（ASC-US、LSIL、HPV+/NILM）是最常见的筛查结局——管理方案不一，导致过度与不足转诊并存。
问题：细胞学 PAX1/JAM3 甲基化能否比现行实践更准确地分流这些女性的 CIN3+？
意义：为最大筛查人群提供客观检测，可标准化管理并减少不必要的阴道镜。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: cross-sectional analysis of prospective screening cohorts (METHY2/METHY3, 2019–2022); Peking Union Medical College Hospital.
Population: 980 ASC-US + 523 LSIL + 354 hrHPV+/NILM; histology: 1071 normal / 419 CIN1 / 200 CIN2 / 149 CIN3 / 18 cancer.
Methylation: CISCER® (ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 or ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0); Cobas 4800; LBC.
Outcome: CIN3+ detection and risk stratification.
bullets_zh: 设计：前瞻筛查队列（METHY2/METHY3，2019–2022）的横断面分析；北京协和医院。
人群：ASC-US 980 + LSIL 523 + hrHPV+/NILM 354；组织学：正常 1071 / CIN1 419 / CIN2 200 / CIN3 149 / 癌 18。
甲基化：CISCER®（ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 或 ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0）；Cobas 4800；LBC。
结局：CIN3+ 检出与风险分层。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: CISCER for CIN3+: sensitivity 74.9% · specificity 89.1% · AUC 0.820 (CIN2+ AUC 0.775) · OR 24.4.
Risk stratification: CISCER(+) post-test CIN3+ risk 40.5% vs 2.7% when negative.
All 18 cancers detected — CISCER caught every invasive cancer in the cohort.
Best subgroups: NILM AUC 0.867; ≥50 y AUC 0.844 — strongest where cytology is weakest.
bullets_zh: CISCER 检测 CIN3+：灵敏度 74.9% · 特异度 89.1% · AUC 0.820（CIN2+ AUC 0.775）· OR 24.4。
风险分层：CISCER(+) 即时 CIN3+ 风险 40.5% vs 阴性 2.7%。
18 例宫颈癌全部检出——CISCER 捕获队列中每一例浸润癌。
最优亚组：NILM AUC 0.867；≥50 岁 AUC 0.844——恰在细胞学最弱处最强。

panels.title: Mechanistic link
bullets: ΔCt gradient: ΔCtPAX1/ΔCtJAM3 decreased monotonically with lesion severity — methylation accumulates as disease progresses.
Dual-gene correlation: PAX1 and JAM3 methylation correlated (R = 0.61) — consistent co-methylation in cervical carcinogenesis.
Actionable: in minimally abnormal results, CISCER(−) supports surveillance over immediate colposcopy.
bullets_zh: ΔCt 梯度：ΔCtPAX1/ΔCtJAM3 随病变加重单调下降——甲基化随疾病进展累积。
双基因相关：PAX1 与 JAM3 甲基化相关（R = 0.61）——宫颈癌变中的一致共甲基化。
可操作：轻微异常结果中，CISCER(−) 支持随访而非立即阴道镜。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: One test for the biggest group: CISCER triages ASC-US/LSIL/HPV+NILM with AUC 0.820 — standardizing minimally abnormal management.
40.5% vs 2.7% risk: clear post-test stratification; all 18 cancers caught.
bullets_zh: 一个检测覆盖最大人群：CISCER 以 AUC 0.820 分流 ASC-US/LSIL/HPV+NILM——标准化轻微异常管理。
40.5% vs 2.7% 风险：清晰的检验后分层；18 例癌全部捕获。

kicker: Cervical Cancer · Int J Cancer 2025;158:1116–1125 · Matched Case-Control
kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · Int J Cancer 2025;158:1116–1125 · 配对对照
title: Enhanced CIN2+ Diagnosis in Postmenopausal Women via PAX1/JAM3 Methylation
title_zh: PAX1/JAM3 甲基化提升绝经后女性 CIN2+ 诊断准确性
subtitle: 216 postmenopausal (≥50 y) vs 212 matched <50 y women — sensitivity 93.2% / specificity 93.6% for CIN2+, AUC 0.934
subtitle_zh: 216 例绝经后（≥50 岁）vs 212 例匹配 <50 岁女性——CIN2+ 灵敏度 93.2% / 特异度 93.6%，AUC 0.934
authors: Peng H, Li J, Zhou Q, Zhou H, et al.
authors_zh: 彭欢子, 李静, 周群, 周慧 等
source: Int J Cancer 2025;158:1116–1125 · DOI 10.1002/ijc.70245
source_zh: Int J Cancer 2025;158:1116–1125 · DOI 10.1002/ijc.70245

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: postmenopausal women have atrophic, low-cellularity cytology — screening accuracy falls with age; false positives drive unnecessary procedures.
Question: does PAX1/JAM3 methylation improve CIN2+ detection in postmenopausal (≥50 y) women?
Why it matters: an age-robust triage could restore screening performance in the group where cytology fails most.
bullets_zh: 空白：绝经后女性细胞学萎缩、细胞量少——筛查准确性随年龄下降；假阳性导致不必要操作。
问题：PAX1/JAM3 甲基化能否提升绝经后（≥50 岁）女性 CIN2+ 检出？
意义：年龄稳健的分流可恢复细胞学失效最严重人群的筛查表现。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: cross-sectional, matched case-control (Jun 2023–Jan 2025); Hunan University of Chinese Medicine 1st Hospital.
Groups: 216 postmenopausal ≥50 y referred for colposcopy + 212 <50 y matched 1:1 by hrHPV/cytology.
Methylation: CISCER® (ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 or ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0, NMPA Class III); Cobas 4800; LBC.
Outcome: CIN2+/CIN3+ detection vs LBC and LBC+hrHPV combinations.
bullets_zh: 设计：横断面、配对病例对照（2023.6–2025.1）；湖南中医药大学第一附属医院。
分组：≥50 岁绝经后转诊阴道镜 216 例 + 按 hrHPV/细胞学 1:1 匹配的 <50 岁 212 例。
甲基化：CISCER®（ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 或 ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0，NMPA Ⅲ类）；Cobas 4800；LBC。
结局：CIN2+/CIN3+ 检出 vs LBC 及 LBC+hrHPV 联合。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: ≥50 y CIN2+: sensitivity 93.2% · specificity 93.6% · AUC 0.934; CIN3+ sensitivity 97.2% (AUC 0.939).
vs LBC: LBC ≥ASC-US 75%/52.3%, AUC 0.637; LBC+hrHPV 81.8%/45.3% — CISCER far superior.
Missed by others: CISCER caught 2 HPV−/LBC− adenocarcinomas and 7 non-16/18 hrHPV cases missed by LBC.
False positives cut >90%: HPV16/18: 28/30; non-16/18: 102/107 avoided needless colposcopy.
bullets_zh: ≥50 岁 CIN2+：灵敏度 93.2% · 特异度 93.6% · AUC 0.934；CIN3+ 灵敏度 97.2%（AUC 0.939）。
vs LBC：LBC ≥ASC-US 75%/52.3%，AUC 0.637；LBC+hrHPV 81.8%/45.3%——CISCER 远优。
他法漏诊者：CISCER 捕获 2 例 HPV−/LBC− 腺癌及 7 例被 LBC 漏诊的非16/18 hrHPV 患者。
假阳性减少 >90%：HPV16/18 减少 28/30；非16/18 减少 102/107 例不必要阴道镜。

panels.title: Age insight
bullets: Higher methylation in elderly: postmenopausal CIN2+ women had higher methylation than younger women — independent of HPV type.
Why it helps: the stronger signal in atrophic cytology compensates for poor cellularity.
Policy: supports methylation-based triage for postmenopausal screening programs.
bullets_zh: 老年女性甲基化更高：绝经后 CIN2+ 女性甲基化水平高于年轻女性——与 HPV 型别无关。
为何有益：萎缩细胞学中更强的信号弥补了细胞量不足。
政策：支持绝经后筛查项目采用基于甲基化的分流。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Age-robust screening: AUC 0.934 for CIN2+ in postmenopausal women — where cytology fails, methylation shines.
97.2% CIN3+ sensitivity with >90% fewer false-positive colposcopies — restores accuracy in atrophic cytology.
bullets_zh: 年龄稳健筛查：绝经后女性 CIN2+ AUC 0.934——细胞学失效处，甲基化大放异彩。
CIN3+ 灵敏度 97.2%且假阳性阴道镜减少 >90%——在萎缩细胞学中恢复准确性。
